_changelog: 2026-09-22T15:53:48+05:30 — Initial patch plan schema, matches DB_PATCHING_SCOPE.md component 3 example — Arvind Regukumar
title: PatchPlan
description: The only shape a Patch Agent output is allowed to take. procedure_id is validated separately against the ProcedureRegistry allow-list before the Executor will look at anything else in this object.

procedure_id.description: Must exist in the ProcedureRegistry allow-list. Never a free-form action.

target.description: Inventory hostname/alias the plan applies to, must match the Scanner's scan for the same target.

risk_notes.description: Optional free-text risk commentary for the human approver's report. Never executed, display-only.
